title: No names in RESCUE: or GAP: signals
rationale: Rescues and gaps print without names (no-shame constraint); stepping in keeps the name as recognition. A RESCUE: or GAP: line that names a person turns a work-state signal into a public mark against someone.
fix: Describe the task, the date and the gap; leave the person out. Use STEPPED-IN: if you want to credit the person who helped.

patterns.message: A roster name appears in a RESCUE:/GAP: signal; these signals print without names.
